summary: IB Acquisition Corp., a Nasdaq-listed Nevada blank-check company, filed an 8-K on October 15, 2026, disclosing that its board set December 16, 2026 as the date of its 2026 Annual Meeting, to be held virtually, with a record date of October 28, 2026. The meeting is the company's first since its IPO and responds to a Nasdaq notice of non-compliance with Listing Rule 5620(a) for failing to hold an annual meeting within twelve months of fiscal year-end. Rule 14a-8 stockholder proposals are due by October 26, 2026. No special-situation transaction is implicated; watch for proxy filing and compliance restoration.
